structure Input where

  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  actionCount : Nat
  displaying   : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => true
  post := fun i o => o.actionCount = i.actionCount ∧ o.displaying = true

example : Spec.pre { actionCount := 5 } ∧
          Spec.post { actionCount := 5 } { actionCount := 5, displaying := true } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
results.bad_example:

negative_examples.example:

structure Play where
  name  : String
  time  : Nat
  counts: Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  user  : String
  play  : Play
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  user  : String
  play  : Play
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.user ≠ ""
  post := fun i o => o.user = i.user ∧
                     o.play.name = i.play.name ∧
                     o.play.time = i.play.time ∧
                     o.play.counts = i.play.counts

results.lean_predicate:
structure Block where
  position : Nat  -- position on a linear axis, e.g., 0, 1, 2, ...
  size     : Nat  -- size of the block, e.g., 1, 2, ...
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Input where
  selectedBlock : Block
  otherBlocks   : List Block
  distance      : Nat
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

structure Output where
  accepted : Bool
  newPositions : List Block
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Spec : Contract Input Output where
  pre  := fun i => i.distance ≥ 5
  post := fun i o => (o.accepted = true ↔
    ∀ b ∈ i.otherBlocks, i.selectedBlock.position + i.selectedBlock.size ≤ b.position - i.distance ∨
                          b.position + b.size ≤ i.selectedBlock.position - i.distance) ∧
    (o.accepted = false ↔
    ∃ b ∈ i.otherBlocks, i.selectedBlock.position + i.selectedBlock.size ≥ b.position - i.distance ∧
                         b.position + b.size ≥ i.selectedBlock.position - i.distance) ∧
    o.newPositions.length = i.otherBlocks.length ∧
    ∀ b ∈ i.otherBlocks, o.newPositions.contains b

example : Spec.pre { selectedBlock := { position := 10, size := 2 }, otherBlocks := [{ position := 20, size := 3 }], distance := 5 } ∧ Spec.post { selectedBlock := { position := 10, size := 2 }, otherBlocks := [{ position := 20, size := 3 }], distance := 5 } { accepted := true, newPositions := [{ position := 20, size := 3 }] } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
results.bad_example:
example : Spec.pre { selectedBlock := { position := 10, size := 5 }, otherBlocks := [ { position := 15, size := 3 } ], distance := 5 } ∧ ¬ Spec.post { selectedBlock := { position := 10, size := 5 }, otherBlocks := [ { position := 15, size := 3 } ], distance := 5 } { accepted := true, newPositions := [ { position := 15, size := 3 } ] } := by
  unfold Spec; decide

negative_examples.example:
example : Spec.pre { selectedBlock := { position := 10, size := 5 }, otherBlocks := [ { position := 15, size := 3 } ], distance := 5 } ∧ ¬ Spec.post { selectedBlock := { position := 10, size := 5 }, otherBlocks := [ { position := 15, size := 3 } ], distance := 5 } { accepted := true, newPositions := [ { position := 15, size := 3 } ] } := by
  unfold Spec; decide
negative_examples.why: The selected block's position + size is within 0.05x of another block's position - 0.05x
